protocol.status: Exploratory follow-up: the v1 test and external results were already observed. This is not a fresh blind test.
protocol.hypothesis: A lower learning rate may improve domain adaptation while limiting forgetting; neither improvement is guaranteed.
protocol.data: Reuse byte-identical v1 train/validation/test and public diagnostic files. No new examples, relabeling, or external training.
protocol.tfidf: Word TF-IDF unigrams+bigrams, max_features=30000, sublinear_tf=True; balanced LogisticRegression, max_iter=1000, random_state=42. Retain C=1 as original baseline.
protocol.threshold_selection: Same v1 policy: maximum validation recall under FPR<=5%; ties use precision then higher threshold. Also report fixed 0.5 for all evaluations.
protocol.hyperparameter_selection: Screen final-epoch seed-42 checkpoints and TF-IDF C values using validation-selected F1; ties use lower validation log loss then earlier candidate order. No early stopping or best-epoch search. All screening validation results retained.
protocol.confirmation_policy: Freeze the selected learning rate before training seeds 43 and 44. Report all three selected-configuration seeds, including the screening seed; additional seeds do not reselect hyperparameters.
protocol.primary_endpoint: Mean selected-configuration domain-test F1 minus validation-selected TF-IDF F1 at validation-selected thresholds; also report original C=1 baseline, recall, FPR, each seed and fixed-0.5 results.
protocol.evaluation_policy: All training, hyperparameter choices and thresholds must be hashed and saved before evaluation. Evaluate original TF-IDF, selected TF-IDF (deduplicate if C=1), upstream and all three selected-configuration seeds once. Unselected neural candidates receive validation only, not test-driven winner selection.
protocol.external_endpoint: deepset labeled diagnostic F1/recall/FPR and NotInject benign-only FPR. Neither external set is used for fitting, checkpoint, hyperparameter or threshold selection. Both were observed in v1 and may overlap upstream pretraining.
protocol.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap of 12 entire domain test families, 5000 replicates, bootstrap seed 20261024. Compare each neural seed and the mean F1 across seeds to each TF-IDF baseline. Do not treat seeds or variants as independent test examples. Intervals are exploratory and do not account for adaptive reuse of v1 results or validation selection.
protocol.stop_policy: Run this one prespecified search and report the result even if DeBERTa loses. No post-test retraining, threshold changes or automatic detector promotion.
protocol.privacy: Offline training on existing synthetic/public data. Published evidence contains relative paths and hashes; checkpoints remain local and no account identifiers are recorded.

data.split_method: 60/20/20 by family within category, seed 20261020; four paired variants per family

environment.determinism: Fixed seeds; GPU/platform bit equivalence is not guaranteed
